description: an athletic young woman archer of the thunder god with a long fair blond braid and a silver circlet, a long dark blue coat with gold embroidered thunder symbols, a silver breastplate with a golden six-petal thunder rosette, silver pauldrons with lightning-shaped edges, brown boots, a quiver of blue-fletched arrows on her back, one single long oak bow held upright in her right hand at her side, only one bow, no arrow on the string, seen from the side in strict profile: the face, chest, hips and feet all turned fully to the right, only one eye visible, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
